info.title: Groot LocalCoinSwap Gateway
info.description: HTTP contract for Groot's loopback LocalCoinSwap preview. Start the server in fixture, public or single-account mode. The exact configured Host and loopback peer are required. JSON request bodies are limited to 8 KiB and JSON responses to 512 KiB. Unknown or repeated parameters are rejected. GET requests have no body. Account operations use the configured local bearer token in account mode and the local test identity in fixture mode. A provider API key is never sent by clients. Invalid methods return 405 with Allow. Account registration, bitcoin escrow signing and settlement are unavailable.

servers.description: Local preview server. The dedicated launcher defaults to port 5310.

get.description: A local bearer token is optional. authenticated indicates fixture access or a valid local token. Upstream key validity and permissions are checked by actual provider calls.

Find BTC/EUR SEPA Instant offers with a recently active maker. Intent describes the Groot user's side. The amount is filtered in the gateway. Provider pagination counts precede local eligibility filtering. Prices are indicative.

items.terms: Send from a bank account in your name.

get.description: Return current terms and indicative price for one BTC/EUR SEPA Instant offer.

data.terms: Send from a bank account in your name.

get.description: Return existing non-custodial BTC/EUR SEPA Instant trades for the connected account.
Return deposits, withdrawals and escrow movements for the connected provider account, newest first. The provider omits self-transfers. This read uses the provider read scope.
Return a normalized trade for the connected account. The gateway omits raw escrow metadata and private files.

Omit view for the legacy offset page. Set view=latest and omit offset to load the newest window, oldest first within that window. The latest response includes its starting offset. A moving window that cannot be verified returns a retryable 503.

200.description: Trade messages in the requested page or latest window.

post.description: Send plain text through the connected account. Keep the same UUID and body when checking or explicitly retrying an interrupted request. Text and attachment metadata are projected without attachment URLs.

The gateway checks expectedStatus against the current state before it forwards an action. LocalCoinSwap enforces ownership, role and transition rules. A payment claim records what the buyer reports. An unfunded cancellation is limited to a newly requested trade.

200.description: Full Trade for mark_paid or cancel_unfunded. TradeStatus for open_dispute or withdraw_dispute.

get.description: Read a previously reserved request from the same account and journal. Readable with account writes turned off. A 200 response can still indicate pending, rejected, or unknown. An unknown receipt blocks replay of that write.

LocalAccess.description: Separate local gateway token for account mode, 32–256 characters from A–Z, a–z, 0–9, underscore and hyphen.

OriginForRead.name: Origin
OriginForRead.description: When supplied, must be the exact configured loopback origin.

OriginForWrite.name: Origin
OriginForWrite.description: Must be the exact configured loopback origin. Browsers attach it automatically.

FetchSite.name: Sec-Fetch-Site
FetchSite.description: Allowed browser fetch metadata when supplied.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: One UUID per write intent. Keep it to check the receipt and reuse it only with the identical request.

IdempotencyKeyPath.name: idempotencyKey
IdempotencyKeyPath.description: Request UUID supplied in the original Idempotency-Key header.

AmountCents.name: amountCents
AmountCents.description: Fiat amount in euro cents, used to filter offer eligibility.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of rows to request.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Zero-based index in provider results. Omit with view=latest.

BtcTransactionType.name: type
BtcTransactionType.description: Select one transaction type. Omit for all types.

ChatView.name: view
ChatView.description: Request the most recent window. Mutually exclusive with offset.

InvalidRequest.description: Malformed request, UUID, query, or JSON body.

Unauthorized.description: Local authorization is missing or invalid, or the provider rejected the configured key as unauthenticated.

Forbidden.description: The local host, origin, marker or peer is invalid, or the provider refused this operation.

WriteForbidden.description: Local request failed origin checks, provider denied the write, or account writes are disabled.

NotFound.description: The requested route, resource or journal receipt is unavailable to this account.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The request method is unsupported for this resource.

WriteConflict.description: Request key conflict, stale trade status, or pending or unknown write outcome. Check the receipt before deciding what to do next.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Send uncompressed application/json, optionally with charset=utf-8.

RateLimited.description: The provider rate limit is active. Honor the supplied retry time.

InvalidProviderResponse.description: The provider response failed validation or exceeded its response limit.

Unavailable.description: The provider or gateway is temporarily unavailable.

InputText.description: Nonblank text up to 1,000 UTF-16 code units. The gateway normalizes line endings and rejects unsafe control and directional characters.

NullableTimestamp.description: Unix milliseconds. A null value means the provider supplied no timestamp.

btcExecution.description: Native bitcoin escrow execution is unavailable in this development gateway.

exactPricePerBtc.description: Exact EUR/BTC price equals units divided by 10 to the power of scale.

txid.description: Lowercase Bitcoin transaction ID when available.

sats.description: Signed provider amount in satoshis when available.

offset.description: Starting index in the message list.

retryable.description: Retry guidance for a read or a known rejected request. Reconcile uncertain writes by request UUID.
